task: Local fixed-backbone retrospective candidate ranking pilot
heavy_atom_completion: PDBFixer1.12.0 addMissingAtoms seed17, OpenMM8.6.1 CPU; missing-residue list empty, no loop modeling; all observed backbone values must be bit-identical after 3-decimal PDB export
parent_processing: The same complete preparation is applied to the parent and every candidate on each template
environment_selection: The original parent template heavy atoms define the prespecified fixed 8Angstrom environment; no mutated-sidechain-specific region selection
static_scoring: Use completed heavy atoms; no static BSA or contact scoring on an incompletely substituted side chain
interpretation: Model input differences are residue-identity changes on fixed experimental backbone coordinates. This pilot does not generate mutant backbone conformations or prospectively validate antigen design.
failure_rule: Record every preparation failure; do not select alternative seeds/rotamers by SPR or model score. A technical repair is documented and applied uniformly before evaluation.
